hypothesis: H7: Five source-section calls with a fixed six-field JSON schema and deterministic nonfactual envelope can deliver a complete selected topic while reducing long source copying and repeated nested keys. All five sections must pass factual/bilingual review; no fragment is promoted if the combined document fails.
comparison: Aggregate generated-token budget equals each prior 1800-token condition. Context decomposition, exact schema and deterministic envelope are combined interventions, so do not attribute effects to one factor or treat repeated family as independent samples. Prefill tokens and total server time measured separately.

renderer_contract.scope: Five selected args.go API groups; not whole repository or command routing.
renderer_contract.example: Existing synthetic MatchAll/ExactArgs/OnlyValidArgs fragment with explicit function/import context; syntax parsed, not typechecked or executed.
renderer_contract.written_tests: args_test.go exists in exact pinned snapshot; no external tests run.
renderer_contract.uncertainty: Shallow clone lacks parent; historical MODIFY is INCONCLUSIVE; absent partial symbols never authorize REMOVE. No general runtime guarantee.
renderer_contract.provenance: Attach deterministic exact source ranges and hashes to each section. Correct citation alone is not semantic verification.
renderer_contract.evaluation: Separate source reconstruction and review against all twelve frozen dimensions. JSON schema is not acceptance.
